profile.name: FOMC Member Speaks
profile.what: Remarks from a regional Fed president or governor.
profile.why_gold: Mostly background, but a known hawk turning dovish - or the reverse - is a genuine signal, and voting members matter more than non-voters.
profile.watch: Whether the speaker votes this year, and whether they are departing from their usual stance.
profile.gotchas: Several speakers a day is normal and almost always noise. Treat as background unless the tone genuinely shifts.

profile.name: Non-Farm Payrolls
profile.what: Net jobs added outside farming, plus the unemployment rate and average hourly earnings, all in one 13:30 UK release on the first Friday of the month.
profile.why_gold: Labour market strength is the other half of the Fed's mandate. A strong report pushes rate-cut expectations out and pressures gold; a weak one brings cuts forward and supports it.
profile.watch: Three numbers land simultaneously and can disagree: the payroll count, the unemployment rate, and average hourly earnings. Revisions to the prior two months often matter more than the headline.
profile.gotchas: The most whipsaw-prone release on the calendar. The first move is frequently wrong, and the first fifteen minutes routinely reverse.

profile.what: Michigan's household survey, released in preliminary and revised form at 15:00 UK.
profile.why_gold: The sentiment number is minor. The inflation-expectations component attached to it is not.
profile.watch: The 1-year and 5-10 year inflation expectations. The Fed watches the long-run figure closely, so a jump there is a genuine rate signal.
profile.gotchas: Small sample, frequently revised, and prone to reflecting petrol prices more than anything else.

profile.name: FOMC Member Speaks
profile.what: Remarks from a regional Fed president or governor.
profile.why_gold: Mostly background, but a known hawk turning dovish - or the reverse - is a genuine signal, and voting members matter more than non-voters.
profile.watch: Whether the speaker votes this year, and whether they are departing from their usual stance.
profile.gotchas: Several speakers a day is normal and almost always noise. Treat as background unless the tone genuinely shifts.
